stance: Policy stance is hawkish-leaning. The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 2026-10-28 as expected, with a 10-2 vote and both dissenters (Cook, Hammack) favouring a 25bp hike. Statement says inflation remains elevated. On the euro area, September HICP rose to 3.75% yoy, above the 3.6% expectation, with core near 2.5%, so the ECB is unlikely to ease. Easing talk would need softer inflation or a drop in energy prices; more dissents for a hike would harden the view.
